description: Phase-1 Ragas-vs-R4 QA eval set. Each case carries everything BOTH harnesses need: question, answer (DocAIQ's), contexts (retrieved passage texts, implicitly c1,c2,... in order), ground_truth (reference answer), expected (R4 key-facts), citations (predicted ids) + must_cite (required ids) for R4 citation_recall, and should_abstain. Synthetic seed (~15 cases) to PROVE the harness + a first proxy-vs-judge correlation; replace/grow with real-document cases for publishable numbers. Mix: answerable (incl. one deliberately UNFAITHFUL answer to show the LLM judge catching what R4's proxy can miss) + should-abstain.
